note: Everything here runs server-side on Higgsfield: the TTS job_id is passed straight into the video job as audio_references, so the exact Spanish wording drives the lip sync and no media has to be downloaded to submit the jobs.

character_reference.look: A Latina woman, 32 years old, warm medium-brown skin, dark brown wavy shoulder-length hair worn loose, minimal natural makeup, plain heather-grey crew-neck t-shirt, seated at a light oak desk in a bright modern home office with a soft-focus off-white wall, a small green potted plant and a closed silver laptop. Soft natural daylight from camera-left. Medium shot from mid-chest up, head in the upper third, generous headroom, 35mm lens look, neutral colour grade, natural skin texture. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks.

voice.requirement: voice_id must be a female Latin-American Spanish voice; audition before use.
voice.note: Runway eleven_multilingual_v2 + languageCode 'es' also works but its MCP surface here exposes no task-fetch tool, so the mp3 cannot be retrieved.
